quest.title: The Vile Phial
quest.description: An enigmatic tome detailing the instructions on how to craft a fabled bottle that is said to be able to hold any type of liquid!

node.journal_entry: "Glass, such a pretty and petty substance. Who decided it should be the universal agent for the common receptacle is absolutely beyond me. I, Garlish the Ever Inventive, have devised a far better substance that, I can guarantee, will hold any substance known to man, ork, elf and so forth..."
"With the materials all carefully gathered, your next task my enterprising protege, is to refine them into their malleable state, ready for the last brilliant step."

"Now, and listen carefully now learned minion, comes the final step. This one is, as they say, a doozy and must not be undertaken lightly or without much care. Now, you must craft, using the items above, what I have dubbed the "Vile Phial!"
"What follows is a (very) brief list of the required materials and where one may find them (other than the market that is, but no craftself of any worth would trust second-hand resources says I!)"

"Congratulations worthy follower you are now the proud owner of one Vile Phial! Surely you may now take this new-found knowledge and craft these wondrous items to your, and by proxy my, hearts content!"

"a) Exactly a fourth of a kilo of Spellblasted Sand from the cursed sands of the land of Ur-Khamset, Rubaiyat. This sand will require further refinement to convert it to a vitrified form. This can be accomplished at any Laboratory with 3 Selentine essences and a (normal for now) bottle."

"b) Exactly three chunks of Spellblasted Granite harvested from the magical battle-worn patches of lava that dot the surface of Cairn. These will need to be refined into 1 vitrified granite at a Laboratory combined with 3 selentine essences and a simple bottle."
